$comment: ★ MSVC'S MIXED-CASE `ll` SUFFIXES (P68 round 11, D-C-MIXED-CASE-INTEGER-SUFFIXES-REFUSED). C 6.4.4.1 spells the long-long-suffix `ll` or `LL` only; MSVC also takes `lL`, `Ll` and the eight spellings that add a `u` or `U` on either side (`ulL`, `uLl`, `UlL`, `ULl`, `lLu`, `lLU`, `Llu`, `LlU`). ✔MEASURED 2026-09-24: MSVC 19.51 compiles them without a diagnostic in its default mode, `/std:c17` and `/std:clatest`, types each EXACTLY as its same-case twin (`ll`, or `ull`) at every magnitude measured, decimal and hexadecimal, and runs this file to 42 at /Od and /O2; gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3, aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc and mingw-w64 gcc refuse all ten ('invalid suffix'). Under `DSS = (gcc ∪ clang ∪ MSVC) ∪ ISO C` one accepting reference makes a spelling REQUIRED; its MEANING is MSVC's own — a synonym of `ll` / `ull` — so the C language document puts each in its twin's 6.4.4.1 group. (MSVC types `ll` itself away from ISO past LLONG_MAX in hexadecimal; DSS keeps ISO's ladder for `ll` and so for its synonyms, and this file stays off that edge.) DSS refused all ten with P_MalformedNumber before (47 diagnostics on this file). What each value proves, by the exit code: 1-2 `lL` and `Ll` as `long long`, 3-10 the eight as `unsigned long long` — each by its TYPE (`_Generic`) and its value against a `volatile`; 11-12 a `long long` of 2^40, decimal and hexadecimal; 13-14 the largest `unsigned long long`. The `#if` blocks pin phase 4. ★ RED-ON-DISABLE: drop one of the ten from both lists and this file does not compile. The `release` arm pins the same file through the shipped release pipeline.
